zh: 一个节点选择“减半”会把它整棵子树里未处理节点的值都右移一位，而选择“扣 K”不影响子树。所以进入一个节点时，真正需要知道的只是它的值已经被整除 2 多少次。
设 dp[u][s] 为进入 u 时子树所有值已被整除 2 共 s 次的最大得分。选扣 K：得 floor(A[u]/2^s)−K，子节点状态仍为 s；选减半：得 floor(A[u]/2^(s+1))，子节点状态变为 s+1。A≤10⁹，s 超过 30 后所有值都是 0，状态只需 0..30。
先迭代求出从根 0 出发的遍历顺序和父节点，再逆序处理（子节点先于父节点）：对每个节点用子节点之和 sum[s] 计算 dp[s]=max((A>>s)−K+sum[s], (A>>(s+1))+sum[min(s+1,30)])，然后把 dp[s] 加到父节点的 sum[s] 上。根的 dp[0] 就是答案，用 64 位整数，单步得分可以为负。
en: Choosing halve at a node shifts the value of every unprocessed node in its whole subtree right by one, while choosing minus K leaves the subtree untouched. So when entering a node, all you need to know is how many times its values have already been halved.

Let dp[u][s] be the best score of u's subtree when every value in it has been halved s times on entry. Minus K gains floor(A[u] / 2^s) - K and the children stay at s; halve gains floor(A[u] / 2^(s+1)) and the children move to s + 1. Since A <= 10^9, every value is 0 after 30 halvings, so s = 0..30 suffices.

First compute, iteratively, a traversal order from root 0 and the parents, then process nodes in reverse so children come before parents. For each node, with the children's totals sum[s], set dp[s] = max((A >> s) - K + sum[s], (A >> (s+1)) + sum[min(s+1, 30)]), then add dp[s] into the parent's sum[s]. The root's dp[0] is the answer; use 64-bit integers, as single steps may be negative.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Tree dynamic programming. Let dp[u][s] be the best score of node u and its subtree when, on entry, all their values have already been integer-divided by 2 a total of s times. Choosing minus K keeps the children at s; choosing halve gives the node floor(A[u] / 2^(s+1)) points and moves the children to state s + 1. After more than 30 halvings every value is zero.

## Proof of correctness

In any valid plan there are exactly two choices at node u. Minus K does not change the values of the unprocessed subtree, so all children stay at state s; halving turns every descendant value of u into the original value shifted right once more, so all children move uniformly to s + 1. Subtrees are not connected to each other, so once u's choice is fixed, each subtree can take its best value independently, and the maximum of the two candidate gains is dp[u][s]. Computing bottom-up covers all plans.

## Complexity

O(31n) time and O(n) extra space.
